summary.text: Donna Howard is a Democratic state representative from Texas House District 48 who has represented the district since 2006 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Donna Howard is a native of Austin, Texas.
She earned a bachelor's degree in nursing and a master's degree in health education from the University of Texas.
She has worked as a critical care nurse at Brackenridge and Seton hospitals and as a health educator at the University of Texas.
Howard was a candidate for the Texas State Board of Education in 2000 and 2002, and served on the Eanes Independent School District board from 1996 to 1999.
She is a co-founder of Advocates for Eanes Schools.
Howard's committee assignments in the 2023-2024 legislative session were Appropriations and Higher Education.
